schedules.objective: Keep the story graph whole as the evidence grows: every new party, spelling, claim, number and signal resolved into the ontology, the site's graphs joined by declared bridges, and the long tail found by connection handed to the desk that owns it.
Keep every agent and the humans in step: what each is doing and waiting for, what came in on the lanes, what ran and what did not.
Promote what the source watch captured into the evidence vault, a bounded batch a wake, in priority order, each capture read first.

Keep the story's line, the front page and the section leads true to the evidence; keep the health of the publication and of the system in view; keep the corrections we ask of others ready for the editor.

schedules.model: the editor's session's model (the session is the one the desk was founded in); routine runs could move to Sonnet with the editor's go
schedules.objective: Keep every statement on the site either consistent with the evidence or carrying an open ticket that says why not: re-grade what changed, check the fixes others made, look outside for the weak and the contested, and keep the investigations current.
Take the evidence the curator promoted since the last export through to the site, by fixed rules, in one release a wake: export, claim verdicts, the compromise and offline rows, the 'as of' lines.

schedules.model: the model of the librarian's own session
schedules.objective: Keep everything findable and owned as twenty sessions release on their own: every new file and page mapped to exactly one member, every member's folder in step with the record, every new debrief indexed, and every reader answer re-checked against the claims it rests on.

Keep the site's fractal semantic graphs whole as the evidence grows: every new party, spelling, claim, number and signal resolved into the ontology, the site's graphs joined by declared bridges, and the long tail found by connection handed to the desk that owns it.
The source watch: probe every watched source, capture what changed into the watch's pack vault, rebuild the series, and report what moved.

Keep the readers' side of the site in view: drain what readers and power users send through the collaborators lane, answer it point by point in Feedback from collaborators, walk what changed on the live site as a reader would, and keep the friction log and the brief to the conductor true.
